diagnostics.message: Chrome did not finish its initial DevTools handshake within the startup window.

evidence.reason:
Chrome DevTools protocol timeout failed: Target.getTargets: timed out after 90000ms [ERR_CHROME_CDP_TIMEOUT]
Chrome process: still running.

Created TensorFlow Lite XNNPACK delegate for CPU.
Windows browser startup may have relaunched before connecting to the DevTools pipe. Retry from a non-elevated PowerShell opened normally, outside an elevated or compatibility-mode parent. Archify does not disable browser de-elevation or the sandbox to preserve pipe handles.
Chrome transport: Node v24.3.0, libuv 1.51.1-dev, win32; pid=11864, exitCode=null, signalCode=null.
Chrome read pipe: readable=true, ended=false, destroyed=false, receivedBytes=0, messages=0, bufferedBytes=0.
Chrome write pipe: writable=true, ended=false, destroyed=false, completedWrites=0, writtenBytes=0, bufferedBytes=50.

supportedFixes: do not edit or simplify the artifact because this is a browser-startup failure
retry browser-check once after host load subsides; if it repeats, stop and report the environment failure
